title: Describe required disclosures including that for noncash transactions

items.concept: Initial recognition of noncash investing/financing transactions; correct SCF investing/financing; noncash disclosure; interest and taxes paid
Noncash disclosure and SCF correction (number-variant twin of Q1)
PPE cash vs noncash purchase schedule; note subsequent measurement; period-end interest AJE; cash principal/interest settlement path; noncash + interest-paid disclosures
Classification — cash investing outflow only; noncash stock excluded from financing
Required supplemental disclosures — interest paid, taxes paid, noncash, restricted cash
